Algorithm 1: Discount Model Search (DMS)
Discount Model Search (\(eval, \boldsymbol{\theta}_0, N, W, \lambda, \sigma, n_{init}, \alpha, n_{empty}, f_{min}\)):
    Input: \(eval\) function that computes objective \(f\) and measures \(m\), initial solution \(\boldsymbol{\theta}_0\), iterations \(N\), num. emitters \(W\), batch size \(\lambda\), initial step size \(\sigma\), initial training points \(n_{init}\), archive learning rate \(\alpha\), num. empty points \(n_{empty}\), minimum objective \(f_{min}\)
    Result: Generates \(NW\lambda\) solutions, storing elites in an archive \(\mathcal{A}\)
    Initialize empty archive \(\mathcal{A}\); discount model \(\hat{f}_A(\cdot; \psi)\) with parameters \(\psi\)
    Sample \(n_{init}\) cells from \(\mathcal{A}\) and regress \(\hat{f}_A\) to output \(f_{min}\) at the centers of these cells
    Initialize \(W\) emitters, each with mean \(\boldsymbol{\theta}^* \leftarrow \boldsymbol{\theta}_0\), covariance \(\boldsymbol{\Sigma} \leftarrow \sigma\boldsymbol{I}\), internal parameters \(p\) for \(iter \leftarrow 1..N\) do
    \(\mathcal{D}_A \leftarrow []\) // Dataset of measures and discount value targets.
    for \(Emitter\ 1..Emitter\ W\) do
        for \(i \leftarrow 1..\lambda\) do
            \(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{\theta}^*, \boldsymbol{\Sigma})\)
            \(f(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i), \boldsymbol{m}(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i) \leftarrow eval(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i)\)
            \(\Delta_i \leftarrow f(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i) - \hat{f}_A(\boldsymbol{m}(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i))\) // Compute improvement based on discount model.
            Compute \(t_{A,i}\) with Eq. 1, where \(s = \boldsymbol{m}(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i)\)
            \(\mathcal{D}_A.append((\boldsymbol{m}(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i), t_{A,i}))\)
            \(e \leftarrow calculate\_archive\_cell(\mathcal{A}, \boldsymbol{m}(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i))\)
            if \(f(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i) > f(\boldsymbol{\theta}_e)\) then
                Replace \(\boldsymbol{\theta}_e\) (the solution in cell \(e\)) with \(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i\)
            Rank \(\boldsymbol{\theta}_i\) by \(\Delta_i\)
            Adapt \(\boldsymbol{\theta}^*, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}, \boldsymbol{p}\) based on improvement ranking \(\Delta_i\)
            if \(CMA-ES\) converges then
                Restart emitter with \(\boldsymbol{\theta}^* \leftarrow\) a random solution from \(\mathcal{A}\), \(\boldsymbol{\Sigma} \leftarrow \sigma\boldsymbol{I}\), new internal parameters \(p\)
    Sample \(n_{empty}\) unoccupied cells \(e_{1..n_{empty}}\) from archive \(\mathcal{A}\) without replacement
    Compute centers \(s_{1..n_{empty}}\) of cells \(e_{1..n_{empty}}\)
    \(\mathcal{D}_A.extend((s_{1..n_{empty}}, f_{min}))\)
    Regress \(\hat{f}_A\) on \(\mathcal{D}_A\)
